subject.title: [bug]：Gateway pairing failure on Trim OS / TerraMaster NAS: WebSocket closes with code 1002 during device proof response

question: Should this be handled as a core Gateway protocol/diagnostic repair, a Trim OS package-owner config-management repair, or deferred until logs identify the failing connect frame?
rationale: The possible fixes touch Gateway device pairing, shared auth, and loopback bypass behavior, while the repository does not contain the Trim OS package manager that allegedly rewrites config.

options.title: Collect proof before auth changes
options.body: Ask for redacted `openclaw gateway --verbose --ws-log full` output, Gateway logs, the failing connect frame, exact CLI/Gateway/package versions, and before/after generated config before choosing a repair.

options.title: Core diagnostic repair
options.body: If the logs show a current OpenClaw client speaking the wrong protocol or producing opaque 1002 diagnostics, fix the Gateway/CLI diagnostic or protocol path without loosening pairing.

options.title: Package-owner repair
options.body: If only `trim.openclaw` regenerates config outside this tree, keep core auth strict and route the config-management fix to the package owner.

recommendation.title: Collect proof before auth changes
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted `openclaw gateway --verbose --ws-log full` output, Gateway logs, the failing connect frame, exact CLI/Gateway/package versions, and before/after generated config before choosing a repair.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across protocol compatibility, gateway client packaging, and device-pairing docs in the affected path.
